title: Maestro MCP v3 Tool Catalog
description: Authoritative catalog for the Maestro MCP tools. Principal and resource scope are derived from the authenticated server context. Version 3.1 extends the frozen 3.0 catalog with the M3 read surfaces (defect, integration run, agent run) and the single structured Agent progress write (no free-text commands); changes require a contract change request through the integration session.
